name: Grupo Rede+
evidence: Dec 16, 2024 blog post confirms Rede+ is accredited by the state Tecnova program (Bahia, Goiás, Sergipe, Maranhão, DF, Ceará) and is actively guiding startups from a recent cohort ('Tecnova III') into further acceleration/funding steps.

name: HARDS
evidence: Site itself still loads and clearly describes a real hardware+software accelerator, but the founding-team bios and footer copyright cap out at 2022, and the most recent cohort news found (3rd acceleration cycle) dates to 2021-2023 with nothing since; no evidence of activity in the last 24 months.

name: I9Space
evidence: i9space.com.br 301-redirects to an unrelated 'under construction' WordPress site (iaextreme.com.br); a related i9spacelab.com.br domain redirects to the same placeholder. No current web presence, and search only surfaces a Brasília-based 'I9Space LTDA-ME' offering ebooks/mentoring content rather than a cohort-based accelerator.

name: IERA Polo de Oliveira do Bairro
evidence: The on-file website is the municipal government site of Oliveira do Bairro, Portugal, not a Brazilian entity at all -- IERA (Incubadora de Empresas da Regiao de Aveiro) is a real Portuguese municipal business-support incubator/co-working space (not a Brazil-based cohort accelerator), and the dataset's hq_country='Brazil' / city='Salvador' appear to be a data error. No news of incubator activity newer than ~2022 was found.

name: INCUBATIC
evidence: Runs the JoInT+ 2025/2026 acceleration program (FACEPE Notice 25/2024, Edital 01/2025) with published final selection results for 6-10 Recife-metro startups; biweekly mentorship, 50% in-person/50% online.

name: Ilhahub de Inovação
evidence: Active Blue Economy innovation hub/accelerator (12-startup portfolio, aiming for 1,000 ocean startups by 2030): led a Brazilian delegation to the June 2025 UN Ocean Conference, partners with Sebrae-SP on the 'Speed Marine' acceleration program, and launched a Blue Economy investment vehicle with Ventiur.

name: Impact Hub Sao Paulo
evidence: Runs the GIZ/BMWK-funded 'Hub de Inovação Climática' acceleration program; a March 28, 2025 post confirms a 15-startup cohort selected (with COP30 Belém participation) and R$451,500 mobilized, backed by a June 2025 program factsheet.

name: Inkuba
evidence: inkuba.com.br has an expired SSL certificate and is unreachable; corporate records instead identify 'Inkuba Comunicação Ltda' as a Cannes Lions-winning digital marketing/advertising agency (clients incl. Unilever, Nestlé), not a startup accelerator.

name: InovaCity
evidence: inovacity.com now redirects to a GoDaddy 'domain for sale' parked page; no web search results found for an 'InovaCity' accelerator in São Paulo, suggesting the entity no longer has any online presence.
